# Outbreaks 
 
Select an outbreak below to view the latest evidence surveillance table and download the current dataset. 
 
Each outbreak has its own concfolder, downloadable CSV, and optional full dataset XLSX file. Columns may differ between outbreaks depending on the surveillance needs for that topic.
